source_limitations: Full macro mapping guide redirects to a member SAML sign-in page. No authentication attempted.
Reporting API dimension labels were inspected but are not treated as a universal collector wire schema.
Known supply-type guards use only documented examples and native SDK defaults. They do not close kv24.
Additional device-ID carrier alternatives, GPS availability and viewability context are not locally observable.
SDKs accept arbitrary caller parameters and overrides. Source emission does not prove receiver acceptance or universal SDK value enforcement.
Decoded kv55 values lose raw inner delimiter distinctions. Node field types, optional-tail boundaries, ext serialization, seller membership and last-node identity remain explicit residuals.
The URI for the separate S2S INGEST service is onboarding-specific. Its session/time/latitude precision requirements are not transferred to /i.

Common reporting recommendations use info-level key presence only. Known app/video labels allow contextual info advice; mixed, absent, unknown and macro discriminators defer. GPS availability, MRAID capability, SDK user IDs, IDFV, DNT and App Version lack sufficient observable context or a published wire mapping.

The legacy URL extractor omits bare keys. Bare kv24 repeats are therefore absent from the condition input; a retained populated value can activate a context guard. Bare form keys are retained as empty. Explicit fixtures preserve this limitation, not a receiver duplicate policy.
URL names/values decode once. A submitted URL key shadows all same-name form values; literal conflicting parsed values defer guards, while unknown body/context fields do not supply requirements.
The linked iOS SDK and Android SDK are historical 2019/2020 source profiles. Current guides still link them, but they do not prove current deployment, receiver acceptance or complete endpoint law.
The 1x1 video guide describes macro capacity, not an unambiguous enforceable parameter-count rejection limit. Unknown custom fields remain open.
OMID viewability dvid=v instructions concern the separate verification JS profile. They are not transferred to /i; the actual iOS builder can emit dvid=dvid.

source_oracle.url_renderer: Local Foundation transcription of the adjacent sender URL-building loop, with a fixed synthetic cachebuster. Original sender, NSURLSession, requests and retries are never compiled or invoked. Dictionary enumeration order is not a wire contract.
source_oracle.android_execution: Java runtime unavailable. Android source constants and builder branches were inspected and pinned, not executed. No runtime or dependency installed.
